description: Delete a folder and its full subtree of child folders (cascade). Every note inside — including notes in nested subfolders — is soft-deleted into the trash along with it (see delete_note), recoverable via restore_note within the retention window. To preserve organization instead, move notes/subfolders out first.

id.description: UUID of the folder to delete along with its subfolders. Notes inside are moved to the trash, not destroyed

name: delete_folder
